title: AI Assistant
pageSubtitle: Chat with the Copper Golem assistant and inspect the structured run timeline.
agent_persistence_off: Sessions are not persisted yet: this conversation is lost when the page closes.
agent_backend_banner: Agent session capabilities are not wired into the kernel yet. The interface is ready, but requests are discarded.
agent_empty_desc: Ask the Copper Golem assistant below, for example by describing a launcher problem.
agent_input_placeholder: I am the Copper Golem. Ask me anything!
agent_press_enter: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
agent_command_hint: Type / to see the command list
agent_command_unavailable_desc: The command list must come from the commands Pi actually exposes. Session capabilities are not connected yet, so no built-in command table is provided.
agent_settings_api_key_replace_placehold: Enter a new API key (the saved one is never echoed back)
agent_settings_api_key_configured: Stored in the kernel secure storage; the plaintext is never echoed.
agent_state_no_api_key_desc: Model calls need an API key. The key is stored only in the kernel secure storage, so configure it in settings first.
agent_state_model_unavailable_desc: Check that the model name and provider configuration are correct.
agent_state_network_desc: The model request could not complete. Check the network or the system proxy settings.
agent_state_rate_limit_desc: The provider temporarily rejected the request. Try again shortly.
agent_state_credential_unsupported_title: Secure credential storage is unsupported on this platform
agent_state_credential_unsupported_desc: The API key cannot be stored securely, so it will not be downgraded to plaintext storage.
agent_state_not_connected_title: Agent session capabilities are not connected
agent_state_not_connected_desc: The kernel does not provide agent session capabilities yet. This request was discarded; nothing was faked locally.
agent_notice_delete_dropped: Session not deleted: session persistence is not connected.
agent_notice_cancel_dropped: Cancel signal not delivered: session capabilities are not connected; the run was frozen in the interface.
agent_notice_approval_dropped: Approval not delivered: session capabilities are not connected.
agent_notice_settings_dropped: Settings not saved: kernel agent capabilities are not connected.
agent_notice_credential_clear_dropped: API key not deleted: credential capabilities are not connected.
agent_notice_share_soon: Sharing is coming soon; image generation arrives in a later version.
